name: MathlibAnnex.CStarAlgebra.CAR.atomicCounterexampleRepresentation
title: The ambient representation of the fixed algebra

content.display_title: The ambient representation of the fixed algebra
content.one_sentence_role: Defines the inclusion representation $\rho_0:T\to B(\mathcal H)$.
content.natural_language_statement: Let $A$ be the completed CAR algebra and $T=C^*(\pi(A)\cup\{L_i:i\in I\})\subseteq B(\mathcal H)$ the algebra generated by the selected direct sum $\pi$ of pure-state GNS representations indexed by their unitary-equivalence classes $i\in I$ and the unitaries $L_i$ from the fixed homogeneity and shell construction. Write $\iota(a)=\pi(a)$ for the embedding $A\to T$. The inclusion representation is $$\rho_0:T\longrightarrow B(\mathcal H),\qquad \rho_0(t)x=t(x).$$
content.definition_explanation: The map $\rho_0$ is the literal inclusion: $\rho_0(t)=t$ as a bounded operator on $\mathcal H$. The source map $\iota(a)$ is $\pi(a)$ regarded as an element of $T$, so $\rho_0\circ\iota=\pi$.
content.assumptions: The GNS direct sum, the unitaries $L_i$ and the generated algebra $T$ are fixed as above. Each $t\in T$ is already a bounded operator on $\mathcal H$.
content.conclusion: $\rho_0$ is a unital $*$-representation and $\rho_0\circ\iota=\pi$. Its definition introduces no new choice of Hilbert space or operators.
content.lean_realization_notes: Faithfulness and irreducibility of this particular inclusion are separate theorems cited below. They are not additional data chosen in the definition; no separability of $\mathcal H$ is assumed.
